description: The school board in Crystal, Texas, incorporated changes to help the Chicano community. The La Raza Unida Party led these changes, which were the adaptations that included bilingual education for kindergarten through third grade, the stop of IQ and English Proficiency test, and more.
descripción: La junta escolar en Crystal, Texas, incorporó cambios para ayudar a la comunidad chicana. El Partido La Raza Unida ayudo en estos cambios, que fueron las adecuaciones que incluyeron educación bilingüe desde kínder hasta tercer grado, la suspensión de las pruebas de coeficiente intelectual y dominio del inglés, y más.

description: The Young Lords Party (YLP) organized a Puerto Rican conference at the Columbia University. The conference's goal is to empower and educate students and liberate Puerto Rico. It also led to the creation of Liberate Puerto Rico Committee in Milwaukee.
